value.rationale: The exact full dihedral-angle spectrum of the intrinsic Euclidean two-row Monge polytope is a motivated natural codimension-two metric invariant. It gives all-q multiplicities, a sharp ridge census and a nonuniform-integrability phenomenon: rare acute ridges shift the scaled mean by -π/24 despite vanishing from the weak limit. The result is not a relabeling of a known facet count or surface-area integral.
